title: OpenClaw Meeting Prep: Let Your Agent Brief You Before Every Call
summary: OpenClaw agents research every meeting contact, pull CRM history, and draft follow-up emails — automatically. Save 30+ minutes per day on meeting prep.
body_markdown: No — by default, the agent creates a draft that you review and send manually. This is the right default for any customer-facing communication. If you want to auto-send for specific low-stakes meeting types (internal status updates, thank-you notes), you can configure that as a separate rule.
